Understanding
OSLO

OSLO reads your plan and shows how sound it is — where it's clear, where it's weak, and what could derail the outcome.

Judgement
You

You

Oversight
You

As reality shifts, OSLO re-reads and updates the picture, so you can adjust and stay on course.

OSLO advises. You lead. That's how an AI-first PM steers to the outcome — augmented, not automated.

i Read this with care
The band is High, but reliability is Low — this read rests on thin evidence, not a strong plan. The limiter is a reliability shortfall, not a CAF weakness. Confirming key dependencies (or adding evidence) would firm it up. This is advisory — the calls stay yours.
What's driving it — click a dimension to see what's behind it
▸Clarity
Details ▾

Goals, scope, and requirements are well-defined and trace to your inputs.
▸Alignment
Details ▾

Whether the plan's elements cohere with each other and with its intended outcomes — does scope cover the intent, does the schedule fit the scope, do owners and dependencies line up, do stakeholders share the definition of done.
▸Feasibility
Details ▾

Resourcing and sequencing aren't yet supportable.
↗ Strengthened
Why ▾
Outcome Confidence sits at Moderate because Feasibility is the lowest dimension — resourcing and sequencing aren't yet supportable — while Clarity is High and Alignment is Moderate. Reliability is Moderate. Its basis: Coverage Moderate, Evidence availability Moderate, How assessable Moderate. Only an analysis update changes this; resolving the top issues raises the read. i See the full basis in the Outcome Confidence pill ↗.

Project summary

What this is. DevNorth 2026 is a one-day, in-person developer conference on Sep 18 for ~450 attendees, funded by sponsors. Success is a well-attended, well-rated event that also generates ~120 sponsor-qualified leads.

Understanding level. OSLO's understanding is Moderate and forming (Orientation stage): intent, context and scope read clearly; feasibility and alignment are still preliminary.

Main limiter. Feasibility is the lowest dimension, held back mainly by an unconfirmed venue Wi-Fi dependency — the single thing doing most to hold the read back right now.

Reliability basis. The read rests on the documents you provided: coverage Moderate, evidence availability Moderate, and how-assessable Moderate.

This reflects OSLO's understanding of the plan — how clear, aligned, and feasible it is.

Share link — a view-only snapshot of this project
A share link shows OSLO’s read as it stood when the link was made. It never re-runs an analysis, and if the project has moved on since, anyone opening it is told they are looking at a previous analysis — never a stale read passed off as current.
A share link is not an export link. A share link is view-only access to this project, live in OSLO — revocable, and relabelled when the read moves on. An export link (in Export) is a frozen copy of one snapshot. Two different things.
Sharing changes no assessment. Only an analysis update does.
